header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. All figures from the 2026 Form PIT-EST instructions (rev. 11/10/25) Tax Computation Schedule; statutory, not indexed. HB 13 / HS 2 for HB 13 (new brackets above $125,000-$150,000 for 2026) was NOT enacted (stalled in House Revenue & Finance, June 2025). Same rate table for all filing statuses; married couples may file 'combined separate' on one return (each spouse taxed separately), which usually lowers tax. Standard deduction $3,250 ($6,500 MFJ); additional $2,500 per taxpayer 65+ or blind when using the standard deduction. Personal credit $110 per exemption, plus an extra $110 credit for each taxpayer 60+. Pension exclusion: up to $12,500 per person 60+ of pension plus 'eligible retirement income' (IRA/401(k)/457 distributions, and also interest, dividends, capital gains and net rental income); under 60 the exclusion is $2,000 of pension income only. Social Security and Railroad Retirement are fully exempt. Wilmington city wage tax excluded.

flags.retirementIncomeExclusion: simplified: 12,500 at 60+ also covers interest/dividends/capital gains/rents; under 60 the exclusion is 2,000 of pension income
